Easyspell

Website

Who they are

Easyspell (by Kant Labs) is an AI spelling-practice app that turns stressful weekly spelling lists into engaging, five-minute games for elementary school students (US grades 1–5). Snap a photo of the weekly list and it becomes an instant gamified study session — listen-and-spell, sentence practice, word review, story mode, progress tracker. No ads, no account needed. iOS + Android.

What they want

  • Goal & audience (from brief): target parents of kids in grades K–5 and elementary teachers looking to eliminate homework battles. Goal = relatable organic engagement + app downloads. CTA: 'check out the app via the link in bio'.
  • Deliverables (from brief): 8 unique videos per cycle, cross-posted to TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts & FB Reels. 9:16 vertical, 20–45s, clear audio, native on-screen captions.
  • Creative angles to model: (1) The Homework Battle — 'POV: Friday spelling tests used to mean tears and frustration until we found this…'. (2) The 5-Minute Routine — snapping a photo of the weekly list turns into an instant gamified study session. (3) Kid Reaction / Over-the-Shoulder — screen-recording or reaction of a child genuinely enjoying their spelling practice.
  • Study below: the competitor cards + keyword sections show the kids-learning / parenting formats that go viral, so you can replicate the winners (relatable parent POVs, kid reactions, 'this app saved homework night').
